summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly buyback transactions under its previously announced share repurchase program. Through June 10, 2026, the bank has spent €3.257 billion, representing ~64.7% of the program's maximum investment amount, and has repurchased ~17.1% of its outstanding shares as of 2021. The program is conducted through multiple trading venues (XMAD, CEUX, TQEX, AQEU). This ongoing capital return is a shareholder-friendly action. Watch for completion timing of the remaining ~35% of the buyback authorization and potential impact on EPS or dividend policy.
